ledger.title: Pump ledger, a torn page
text: Day 380. Filters changed. Pressure holding at sixty.
Register says eleven. I count ten in the ruins, wandering, tags on their wrists like they were told. One is missing and I know which.
Do not write the name. You asked me not to.
Pump first. Scrubber second. Everything else is a luxury now, including me.

memo.title: Meridian Trust, internal memo
text: For every sleeper brought out of cold storage the Valley must hold, at minimum: one bed under a roof, three litres of clean water a day, enough grain and roots for two thousand calories, and a wall between them and whatever is outside.
Wake them faster than the Valley can hold them and you will lose them twice.
The Director has the final say on the order. The Director has asked that nobody envy that job.

letter.title: A letter, never sent
text: They say Nell goes under on Thursday with the second group. They let me hold her hand until the lid. She was brave. I was not.
They say she wakes when the valley is ready. I asked how they decide when it is ready and the man in the grey coat just said, enough food.
So I am going to grow food. Wherever they put me. Every day. Until somebody says it is enough.

notice.title: Notice, nailed to a post
text: Farms and holdings on the west road pay a fair share to those who keep it. Pay and your trucks get through. Pay and your crops stay in the ground.
Signed with a mark like a split leaf.

tape.title: Cassette label, written in pencil
text: The tape inside is ruined, wound round itself into a knot.
The handwriting on the label is yours.
